metadata.author: Koala Moon
metadata.description: This bedtime story follows Koko the Koala on a magical sleepover in Sleepy Forest, where he discovers Snaffles’ enchanting Sunset Symphony beneath the glowing Koala Moon. Through gentle storytelling and soothing bedtime rituals, this tale celebrates friendship and the comforting magic of nighttime routines. A peaceful story of music and moonlight, helping little ones feel safe, calm and ready for sleep.
